protocol_role: Prospective design defaults, not fitted or validated hyperparameters

BG.role_note: Engineering reference with long-gap evidence gates; not a pure GMC factorial contrast to B

eligibility.track_state: Tracked after the high-score stage, unmatched at that stage
eligibility.detection_source: Original low-score detections with exact original frame and det_index
eligibility.low_score_band_source: Actual pinned baseline masks; expected 0.10 < score < 0.50, verify exact boundary at T0
eligibility.pair_budget: All original geometrically feasible low-stage edges; if resource cap is needed freeze it before training and report truncation
eligibility.failed_support_action: Fallback to original edge/measurement; no default veto

history.source: Raw boxes of actual accepted detections, no prediction outputs, no GT-cleaned runtime history

model.name: tco_small_conv_v1
model.history_conditioning: Masked target and context pooling, age encoding, history attention, current spatial correlation
model.pixel_normalization: RGB/255 mapped to [-1,1]; fixed, no test-video statistics
spatial_fusion_coordinates: x relative to proposal center divided by raw width
y relative to proposal center divided by raw height

head_output_activations.box: linear then bounded tanh residual parameterization

model.quality_target: Identity-conditioned localization quality: same-identity positive uses IoU with the historical GT identity, confirmed negative uses zero; refined target and quality-sampling coordinates detached; unknown labels masked

P1_geometry.inputs: Same scalar geometry/score/time information; no pixels
P1_geometry.role: Information control, not a capacity-matched image model

P2_current_rgb.history_slots: Repeat one crop from the current raw proposal using history ROI specification; preserve actual history-slot validity and age metadata; identical augmentation across repeated slots

shuffled_history.when: After P2/P3 show a local signal
shuffled_history.role: Fixed P3-model diagnostic with other-track historical pixels, no future frames; not a fifth training arm

reachability_diagnostics.exact_gt_reachability: Check whether true GT center and scale lie in the fixed residual domain
reachability_diagnostics.gt_guided_feasible_correction: Clamped residuals or finite grid search are diagnostic reference results, not proven maximum-IoU upper bounds
reachability_diagnostics.ideal_selection_bound: Offline GT selection/localization over explicitly fixed candidate support, ignoring image identifiability
reachability_diagnostics.human_visibility_review: Separate sampled diagnostic with sampling probabilities and full cohort denominator

training.checkpoint_selection: Net correct-box gain within a pre-registered damage budget for originally correct observations; exact budget and denominator must be frozen at T1 before first training

fixed_pair_refine.association: Run the reference low-stage assignment on this run's own current state, then refine accepted low measurements only

low_stage_pair_refine.association: Pair-specific boxes on original feasible and guard-allowed edges, original one-to-one solver and threshold

evaluation.bootstrap_metrics: Recombine metric sufficient statistics or rerun evaluation; never average sequence HOTA percentages
evaluation.latency: True online crop, network and tracker overhead; cached replay is not end-to-end FPS
